editorial.blurb: A Greektown institution since 1970, Golden Fleece delivers theatrical Greek classics in a cozy, authentic space where the energy—and the saganaki flames—are unmistakably real.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive ready to cheer when saganaki comes to the table and the server shouts 'Opa!' before flaming the cheese; the ritual is as essential as the dish itself.

topDishes.note: Beautifully charred outside, melted and stretchy inside; the theatrical 'Opa!' moment is unforgettable
Called 'the best gyros, period' by long-time regulars
Slow-simmered overnight in tomatoes, red wine, and Mediterranean herbs with deep, rich flavor
